description: This file provides functions and types for managing Windows registry keys related to the 'regstate' package, including creating, opening, removing, and querying registry keys, with specific focus on volatile keys and error handling.

classes.name: Key
classes.description: Represents a Windows registry key with additional path information.

classes.name: NotFoundError
classes.description: Error indicating a registry ID was not found.

classes.name: NoStateError
classes.description: Error indicating a specific state for an ID is missing in the registry.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens or creates a registry key at a specified root path, optionally per user.

methods.name: RemoveAll
methods.description: Removes all registry entries under a specified root ID.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new registry entry with a specified state.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets a registry value for a given ID and key.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Deletes a specific registry value for a given ID and key.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a registry value for a given ID and key.
